content:
Issuance copies `bank_version` and `bank_legal_name` from the account. A submitted synchronization changes those fields only when its event completes. Issuing before that event can therefore produce a new letter with the earlier name.

If the bank profile already matches the required registered identity, a further synchronization is not required for issuance. Later legal revisions do not rewrite an existing letter. A reviewing platform separately checks identity, addressee and letter age at its review time.
